reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Fund uses, county policies, and state rulemaking prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1973 H.B. 222). Covers restricting county aid road trust fund receipts to road, bridge, and highway construction, reconstruction, maintenance, and repair within the county as directed by the county commission, mandatory written commission rules/policies filed with the county recorder for public inspection, and prohibiting state highways and transportation commission expenditure rules (declaring prior rules null and void).

headings.title: Monthly state treasurer distribution to counties
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Covers the state treasurer's duty to remit each county's allocated share of the county aid road trust fund to the county treasurer by the tenth day of each month.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and history note (L. 1973 H.B. 222) and verified all fingerprints. Checked exclusive county road/bridge/highway use of CART fund receipts, mandatory written county commission policies filed with the county recorder, prohibition/nullification of state highways and transportation commission expenditure rules, and monthly remittance by the state treasurer by the tenth day; both drafted titles retained.

headings.title: Authorized per-acre tax on agricultural and horticultural property
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1998 H.B. 1113 § 1 through A.L. 2015 H.B. 613). Covers permissive ordinance authority of third- or fourth-classification county governing bodies to levy an additional tax up to one dollar per acre on real property classified as agricultural and horticultural under section 137.016 (noting the archived source retains "cents per acre" in the subsection 3 ballot form).

headings.title: Tax collection and Special Road Rock Fund use
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Covers collection by the county collector, remittance to the county treasurer for deposit in the "Special Road Rock Fund", and appropriation by the county governing body solely to purchase road rock for county roads within county boundaries.

headings.title: Voter approval requirement and ballot form
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 (including ballot block) and history note. Makes any subsection 1 tax ordinance ineffective without submission to qualified county voters at an election permitted under section 115.123 and sets the substantial ballot form (retaining the archived source discrepancy where the ballot form states "cents per acre" while subsection 1 states a maximum of "one dollar on each acre").

headings.title: Effect of election outcome and resubmission
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Covers authority to levy by ordinance up to the ballot-proposed rate upon a majority "YES" vote, prohibition on levying upon a majority "NO" vote, and preserving authority to resubmit a rejected proposal at a section 115.123 election.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all four subsections (including ballot block in subsection 3) and history note (L. 1998 H.B. 1113 § 1 through A.L. 2015 H.B. 613) and verified all fingerprints. Checked third-/fourth-classification county scope, section 137.016 agricultural/horticultural property classification, Special Road Rock Fund restriction, section 115.123 election/resubmission rules, and confirmed the archived source discrepancy where subsection 1 caps the tax at 'one dollar on each acre' while the subsection 3 ballot form retains 'cents per acre'; all four drafted titles retained without silent repair.

headings.title: Two-year appropriation limit beginning fiscal year 1979-80
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1979 S.B. 109 § 2). Preserves the exact archived historical scope: general assembly appropriation of not more than $18 million per fiscal year for two fiscal years beginning with fiscal year 1979-80 for local road and bridge purposes under sections 231.450 to 231.460.

headings.title: Timing of payment by commissioner of administration
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Covers payment of appropriated funds by the commissioner of administration as soon as practicable after the beginning of each fiscal year.

headings.title: Local recipients, permitted uses, and state-road exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Covers payment to county and city governing bodies without formal application, restriction solely to local road and bridge purposes, and prohibition on spending any portion on a road or bridge wholly or partially maintained by the state transportation department.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all three subsections and history note (L. 1979 S.B. 109 § 2) and verified all fingerprints. Checked the archived two-fiscal-year appropriation limit beginning fiscal year 1979-80 ($18 million cap for sections 231.450 to 231.460), commissioner of administration payment timing, and county/city recipient rules barring expenditure on state-maintained roads or bridges; all three drafted titles retained.

headings.title: St. Louis City share and nonparticipation in remainder
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1979 S.B. 109 § 3). Covers paying 5% of the annual appropriation to the city of St. Louis and barring St. Louis from otherwise participating in the distribution as either a city or a county.

headings.title: County share under constitutional formula and section 231.441
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Covers paying two-thirds of the remainder to counties on the same basis as county aid road trust funds under Missouri Constitution Article IV, Section 30(a)(1), to be expended under section 231.441.

headings.title: Municipal share and bar on state commission rules
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Covers distributing the remaining share to incorporated cities, towns, and villages under Missouri Constitution Article IV, Section 30(a)(2) for the same purposes without considering prior motor fuel tax levies, and denying the state highways and transportation commission authority to promulgate expenditure rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all three subsections and history note (L. 1979 S.B. 109 § 3) and verified all fingerprints. Checked 5% St. Louis City share with nonparticipation in the remainder, two-thirds county share under Mo. Const. Art. IV, § 30(a)(1) expended under section 231.441, and municipal remainder under Art. IV, § 30(a)(2) disregarding prior motor fuel taxes plus prohibition on state commission rulemaking; all three drafted titles retained.
